description: Star Relay is a turn-based relay puzzle: rotate tiles on a small grid to carry power from the reactor to the beacon before the move budget runs out, across twelve levels in two packs plus a daily board.
devlog: The second arcade ship is the deliberate opposite of the first: no canvas, no animation loop, no timer. Star Relay renders real button tiles on a CSS grid and keeps every rule in a small state machine that only runs when the player acts, so the page does zero render work while idle. Boards generate from a solved path and then scramble, which keeps all twelve levels solvable by construction without a solver. Relay II adds six larger 6x6 boards, and a daily board deals one shared 6x6 grid per UTC day without touching campaign progress. Power flow is recomputed on each move and lit through token colors, and progress plus best score live in guarded integer browser keys. Sound is a few oscillator bleeps created after the first gesture, with a mute switch.
pitch: Twist relay tiles to link the reactor to the beacon. Twelve quiet levels in two packs plus a daily board, a move budget, no timer.
title: Star Relay
